verdict.description: request_changes when there is any blocker or major finding, otherwise approve.

summary.description: Two or three sentences on the change and its overall risk.

findings.description: Material findings only. Do not invent problems to fill the list.

severity.description: blocker: must not merge. major: real defect or risk to fix. minor: worth fixing. nit: optional polish.

line.description: 1-based line in the candidate, or null.

detail.description: What is wrong, why it matters and the smallest fix.

case.description: The concrete case: an input, a sequence of events, or a use the project has now. Not 'could' or 'might'.

trace.description: The steps you verified, each as path:line and what happens there.

introduced_by_change.description: true if the change introduced the problem or left it in code it touched; false if it lies outside the change.

coverage.description: What the review checked: one entry per numbered definition-of-done item of its prompt, in order.

item.description: The definition-of-done item it reports on, as "<number>. <short name>".

status.description: checked: no finding. finding: reported in findings. rule_only: a rule violation with no concrete case. not_checked: not looked at.

detail.description: finding: the 1-based finding number(s). rule_only: the rule, the location as path:line, and why no concrete case could be shown. not_checked: why. checked: what was checked, briefly.
